name: Checkout
description:
As a shopper
  I want to check out the products in my cart
  So that I can place an order

elements.name: Guest checkout places an order

steps.name: I have added "iPhone" to the shopping cart
I proceed to checkout
I check out as a guest with valid personal details and address
I choose the shipping method "Flat Shipping Rate"
I agree to the terms and conditions
I choose the payment method "Cash On Delivery"
I confirm the order
the page heading is "Your order has been placed!"

elements.name: A logged-in customer reaches checkout without the account step

steps.name: I am logged in
I have added "MacBook" to the shopping cart
I proceed to checkout
the page heading is "Checkout"
the guest checkout option is not offered

elements.name: Checkout with an empty cart returns to the shopping cart

steps.name: I open the checkout page
the page heading is "Shopping Cart"
I see the message "Your shopping cart is empty!"

elements.name: The order cannot be confirmed until the terms and conditions are accepted

steps.name: I have added "iPhone" to the shopping cart
I proceed to checkout
I check out as a guest with valid personal details and address
I choose the shipping method "Flat Shipping Rate"
I choose the payment method "Cash On Delivery"
the order cannot be confirmed
I agree to the terms and conditions
the order can be confirmed

name: Customer registration
description:
As a new visitor of the OpenCart store
  I want to create a customer account
  So that I can log in, save a wish list and check out faster
